verdict.rationale: FreshBooks is a SaaS accounting platform, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack documents only a REST API, OAuth, webhooks, and a NodeJS SDK. These are developer building blocks that could be used to construct an MCP integration, but no official MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint is mentioned, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
